name: Asymmetric Conditional Substitution Hazard & Beta-Binomial 60-Minute Survival
mechanism: Decouples 60-minute threshold survival from mean duration via position-conditioned Beta-Binomial Empirical Bayes.
inputs: features.position; features.chance_of_playing; history.minutes_ped_lag1; history.starts_ewm_19; history.sixty_plus_given_start_ewm_19; history.prior_season_starts; history.prior_season_sixty_plus_starts
replaces: Replaces the linear p_60_plus_given_start calculation inside ParticipationStateHybridModel._compute_participation_states and updates H3 duration-to-threshold mapping in AdaptiveCausalChallengerModel.
nearest_ledger_row: Apex Predator Challenger (Composite ML p_start + start duration + shrunk xG goals + LOO assist finishing with GW1-9 Champion stability and schedule congestion)

name: State-Decoupled Cameo Event Intensity & Late-Game Fatigue Scaling
mechanism: Separates starter vs substitute per-minute event intensity with EB shrinkage (K_sub=450) and conservation adjustment.
inputs: features.position; history.sub_minutes_cum; history.start_minutes_cum; history.sub_xg_cum; history.sub_xa_cum; history.prior_season_sub_minutes; history.prior_season_sub_xg
replaces: Modifies minute-scaling of event rates inside ParticipationStateHybridModel._project_event_components where xmins / 90.0 currently scales xg_per_90 and xa_per_90 uniformly.

name: Leave-One-Out Teammate Receiver Finishing Multiplier for Expected Assists
mechanism: Models finishing efficiency of LOO club teammates with EB shrinkage and bounded tanh assist multiplier.
inputs: features.team_id; history.player_goals_ewm; history.player_xg_ewm; history.club_goals_ewm; history.club_xg_ewm; history.prior_season_club_goals; history.prior_season_club_xg
replaces: Replaces or augments the Group B LOO assist finishing head in MLComponentChallengerModel._apply_assist_finishing_adjustment and operates across all 38 GWs rather than waiting for GW 20.

name: Shot-Quality Decoupled Goalkeeper Save Volume & Exact Step-Tier Expectation
mechanism: Decouples goalkeeper saves via SoT volume minus expected GC with exact Poisson step-tier floor expectation.
inputs: features.position; features.team_id; features.opponent_id; history.club_sot_conceded_per90_eb; history.opp_sot_for_per90_eb; history.league_avg_sot_per90; history.saves_per90_eb
replaces: Replaces goalkeeper save projection in ComponentBaselineModel._project_goalkeeper_saves and CalibratedMatchupHybridModel.
nearest_ledger_row: Club SoT volume x pooled save rate (Shots-on-target faced/90 = club GKP (saves+GC)/mins shrunk; x keeper save rate shrunk to 0.67; pool 0.5/1.0; K50/K200)

name: Price-Stratified Huber-Regularized Continuous-N_{\text{eff}} Causal Panel
mechanism: Price-stratified Huber causal panel with position-by-price centering and continuous N_eff sample size ramp.
replaces: Replaces the global Ridge regression fit and GW 20 step ramp in AdaptiveCausalChallengerModel._compute_ml_blend_weight and MLComponentChallengerModel._fit_predict_panel_heads.

name: Opponent Possession-Adjusted Defcon Threshold Survival Model
mechanism: Scales Defcon mean rate by opponent defensive action demand while locking Negative Binomial dispersion at r=3.0.
replaces: Modifies ComponentBaselineModel._project_defcon_points by introducing the shrunk opponent demand multiplier M_{\text{opp\_dc}, o}(g) prior to the Negative Binomial survival evaluation.
